# An error on a range's pipeline is reported with the pipeline as context,
# without the right delimiter of the range action.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
! muxt check
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:2:13: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\.Result\.Name>: range can''t iterate over string$'
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:3:13: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\$i, \$x := \.Result\.Name>: range can''t iterate over string$'
stderr -count=1 'template.gohtml:4:13: executing "GET / Index\(\)" at <\.Result\.Name>: range can''t iterate over string$'
! stderr '}}>'

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<ul>{{range .Result.Name}}<li>{{.}}</li>{{end}}</ul>
<ul>{{range $i, $x := .Result.Name}}<li>{{$x}}</li>{{end}}</ul>
<ul>{{range .Result.Name -}} <li>{{.}}</li>{{end}}</ul>
{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))

type T struct{}

type Data struct {
	Name string
}

func (T) Index() Data { return Data{} }
